## GET `/103/system/alert`

**Tier:** T0  

This call queries for a list of All Alert ids across all systems

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Jobs that have a Job name associated, e.g. equal to "name=name1" or contains "name=< like>name" |
| `description` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alerts that have the specified description e.g. equal to "description=description1" or contains "description=< like>description" |
| `severity` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that has the following severity: NORMAL, INFORMATION, MINOR, WARNING, CRITICAL, FATAL |
| `state` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that has the following state: NEW, ACKNOWLEDGED, CLEARED |
| `created_date` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that are greater than(">1"), Less than("<1") or equal to the specified created_date "MMM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss.SSS" |
| `created_date_milliseconds` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that contain greater than(">1"), Less than("<1") or equal to the specified date in milliseconds |
| `acknowledged` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that are acknowledged or not (true/false) |
| `array` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that are associated with the specified array e.g. equal to "array=000213234443" or contains "description=<like>443" |
| `object` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that are associated with the specified array object e.g. equal to "object=SRP_3" or contains "description=<like>_3" |
| `object_type` | query | array of string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Alert Ids that are associated with the specified array object type e.g. equal to "object_type=Symmetrix" or contains "description=<like>Symm" |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `listAlertResult` · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error

| `object` | query | array of string |  | Filter alerts that associated with a secified object: e.g. equal to "object=SRP_3" or contains "description=< like>_3" |
| `object_type` | query | array of string |  | Filter alerts that are associated wiith a speciified array object type,e.g. equal to "object_type=Symmetrix" or contains "description=<like>Symm" |

**Request body** (required): `inline`

**Responses:** `200` OK → `listAlertResult` · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error
